svg.title: UPI Guard datathon schema ER diagram
svg.desc: Star schema with dim_customer and dim_merchant feeding fact_transactions and fact_chargebacks. Risk tables are 1:1 rollups. Fraud edges and clusters model collusive rings.
svg.text: PK primary key · UQ unique · FK logical LEFT JOIN key

Logical LEFT JOINs (sql/04_create_relationships.sql). Unmatched ids are kept for fraud analysis. fraud_cluster_members.entity_id is polymorphic: user → dim_customer.user_id, merchant → dim_merchant.merchant_id.
